thread:
Maria Chen: Hey team — need to swap my Sat night oncall (Sat 10:00 PM -> Sun 6:00 AM). Kid has a minor surgery on Friday and I'll be out overnight Friday->Sat. Anyone able to cover the whole block? I can trade a weekday evening (Mon/Wed) in return. cc @AJ :pray:

AJ Patel: I can do the first half (10pm-2am) but I have a wedding rehearsal 3pm Sat so can't take the tail end. Sorry :/

Kevin O'Neill: I could pick up 2am-6am if that helps. Not ideal but doable.

Maria Chen: @Kevin thanks — would love full coverage if possible. If someone can take 10pm-2am then we're set. I can cover a Mon evening next week in exchange.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please update the oncall calendar and runbook after swaps. https://calendar.redwood.com/oncall

AJ Patel: actually I can move some plans — I can extend to 11pm-2am only. can't do earlier than 10:45 though.

Kevin O'Neill: Hmm. I can start at 1:30am and do to 6am. So we still have 10pm-1:30am gap. Anyone else?

Maria Chen: pinging #eng to see if anyone is free. If no takers by EOD I'll ask ops to cover.

AJ Patel: if @kevin takes 1:30-6, I can slide in 11-1:30. That covers everything except 10-11. I'd be happy to swap a Mon night for that 1 hour if someone can pick 10-11.

Kevin O'Neill: ok plan: AJ 11:00-1:30, me 1:30-6:00. Maria needs 10:00-11:00 — any volunteers?

Maria Chen: handoff checklist (please follow):
```
- Update rota in PagerDuty and #oncall-calendar
- Post short handoff note in thread
- Check scheduled jobs: DB vacuum 01:30 UTC Sat (might overlap)
- Run quick health check: `curl -s https://status.redwood/api/health | jq .`
- If anything urgent: call mobile and escalate to SRE lead
```

AJ Patel: I'll update PD once it's confirmed.

Tim L (from #eng replies): I can cover 10-11pm if the team's good with that. Not on participants list but offering.

Maria Chen: @Tim you're a hero, thank you! Ok final assignment: Tim 10:00-11:00, AJ 11:00-1:30, Kevin 1:30-6:00. Maria out.

oncall-bot: Swap recorded. Please confirm you've all updated your personal calendars.

Kevin O'Neill: confirmed — updated calendar and PD note.

AJ Patel: confirmed. I'll also leave a quick note in the handoff doc before I start.

Maria Chen: super grateful. I'll DM each of you details about the surgery timing. Back on Monday night for the trade. :heart:

oncall-bot: Note: If you need to escalate, follow the emergency escalation chain linked in the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/escalation
